notes.title: Another free game!?!?!
notes.content:
Yep, another free game. This weekend I took part in the Ludum Dare 41 game jam. Everyone who signed up was tasked with creating a game completely from scratch in the span of a single weekend based on a secret theme. Well, the weekend came, the theme was revealed (combine 2 incompatible genres), and I made a game. I present to you, RPongG. You can find my submission here, https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/41/$81951

I combined Pong with RPG battle mechanics. Pong is a genre, right?

Anyway, it's free, so if that sounds like fun, enjoy.

notes.title: AMA on r/indiegaming this Friday!
notes.content:
Ahead of the release of Doors Quest Demo this Friday the 20th of April, I will be hosting an AMA likely titled "I didn't know how to make games, so I made a bad one, AMA!" to begin around 5pm Eastern time. If you have any questions about the game, or about the process behind making and publishing an indie game with almost no knowledge or skills, and an even smaller budget, I will answer them! Or maybe you have a question about the melting point of magnesium thiodipropionate. This is an Ask Me Anything, after all, so, it doesn't have to be about games I guess.

So come join me, it should be fun!

~Nick Page!
